reason: The plugin is primarily a UI/navigation enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: it intercepts and replaces the built-in plugin list tab in the web settings view to present official and user-installed plugins in separate groups, improving discoverability and management without introducing code-generation, automation, or data-processing workflows.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 设置中的插件列表页面，按官方插件与自装插件分组显示，便于用户快速定位和管理已安装插件。
summaries.en: This plugin modifies the DeepSeek Harness web plugin list page to separate official plugins from user-installed plugins so users can find and manage their own plugins more easily.

capabilities: Patches the DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin inventory tab via a Cordis bundle patch.
Groups plugin inventory entries into official and user-installed sections for easier navigation.
Uses the existing pluginInventory service flow rather than adding new backend services.

reasons.code: README explains the feature as splitting the plugin list into official and user-installed groups in the settings inventory tab.
README states the built-in official read-only inventory tab is disabled and replaced with a custom grouped tab.
package.json declares a dsh bundle patch entry and web client platform, indicating a UI-level integration path.
Repository tree contains only plugin code, patch file, and docs, with no backend or CLI utility components.
